From Illustrative to Measured: Task-Oriented Semantic mIoT over NTN

Trace-driven evaluation for remote agriculture (irrigation decisions) and environmental monitoring (flood warnings) — semantic / task-oriented reporting vs raw periodic, compressed periodic, and event-triggered baselines.

All numbers below are measured from the simulation (mean ± sd over 5 held-out seeds, 201–205; deterministic pipeline), not assumed. Full detail: RESULTS_SUMMARY.md · Code: github.com/ysrao/semantic-miot-ntn

42.6×
Byte reduction, semantic vs raw (agriculture). 18.9× from report suppression × 2.25× from payload shrinkage (260 B → 80 B).
1,600 vs 50
Devices/beam at 95% deadline success — irrigation: semantic vs raw.
400 vs 0
Devices/beam for flood warnings (45-min deadline): raw and compressed support none; semantic supports 400.
0.93 vs 0.16
Flood-warning recall: semantic vs raw at 100 devices/beam.
~99%
Device energy saving over 90 days (286 J vs 28,275 J). Load-dependent — ≈95% uncongested; modeled NB-IoT-class figures, not hardware measurements.
19.6× / 104.6×
Task-oriented gain GTO — agriculture / flood warning.

Stage 2 — Supportable population M* (deadline success ≥ 0.95)

Configured LEO scenario: 600 km, 48 passes/day × 900 s (ρ = 0.5), 180 kHz, 16 kbps, 2 s random-access slot, ≤ 3 attempts/pass with retries across passes.

Apprawcompressedevent-triggeredsemantic
agriculture (D = 6 h)5050 (100 burst)2001600
environment (D = 45 min)00800 (400 burst)400

Raw/compressed collapse to M* = 0 for flood warnings: at even 50 devices/beam, congested slotted-ALOHA access cannot meet the 45-min deadline with 95% reliability. Burst robustness (5% of devices in one pass, M = 800): agri semantic holds Pr(delay ≤ D) = 1.00; env semantic 0.93 → 0.75; raw/compressed remain at 0.

Stage 3 — Task quality at M = 100 devices/beam

Device and receiver use the identical decision rule (threshold + 2-sample persistence + hysteresis + causal moving-average smoothing); thresholds tuned on seeds 101–105, evaluated on held-out seeds 201–205.

Energy (per device / 90 days, at M = 100)

Apprawcompressedevent-triggeredsemanticNet saving S_E
agri28,275 J27,197 J1,566 J286 J99.0%
env28,310 J27,240 J291 J374 J98.7%

Raw's energy is dominated by access retries under congestion (≈25.8 kJ of retransmissions at M = 100); semantic's by idle listening, sensing and inference. The 99% figure is load-dependent: at uncongested load the saving from fewer transmissions alone is ≈95%. Break-even: semantic still saves energy for AI inference costs up to ≈300 mJ (agri) / ≈100 mJ (env) — orders of magnitude above the modeled 0.1–1 mJ.

A stale flood threshold (tuned on a dry season with zero flood examples) causes both misses and false alarms; one downlink threshold update restores oracle performance at negligible cost. Agriculture thresholds generalize across seasons.

Negative findings — reported, not hidden

  • Raw/compressed periodic reporting cannot support flood warnings at any modeled population (M* = 0) — a hard negative for the conventional baseline.
  • Semantic flood recall is 0.928, not 1.0 — the 7% gap is access loss at M = 100, not decision error (with ideal delivery the rule's recall is 1.0).
  • Agriculture decisions arrive 5–8 h early on average in all modes (8 h timing error) — a property of the slow soil-moisture dry-down trace and threshold rule, not of semantic reporting. For irrigation the earliness is low-cost, but it is reported as measured.
  • Energy savings are congestion-amplified; the uncongested saving is ≈95%, not 99%.
  • The env dry-season tuner degenerates (no flood examples → most conservative offset); the threshold-update mechanism exists because of this.

Assumptions to sanity-check

  • Energy values are modeled, not measured (NB-IoT-class: sensing 2 mJ, AI 0.1–1 mJ, access 250 mJ/attempt, TX 0.5 µJ/bit, idle 15 µW).
  • The NTN scenario is a single configured case (600 km LEO, 48 passes/day, 16 kbps) — no multi-constellation sweep.
  • Traces are synthetic (water-balance soil moisture; leaky-integrator river level) with calibrated noise — no real sensor datasets.
  • Slotted-ALOHA access with geometric retries; no power control, capture effect, or NB-IoT NPRACH modeling.
  • Device ≡ receiver decision rule by construction — the semantic gain is from where/when data is sent, not from a smarter model.
  • Deadlines (6 h agri, 45 min env) and the 0.95 success criterion are application assumptions.

Reproduce

python3 src/ntn_eval/run_all.py   # ~2.5 min; regenerates results/ and figures/

Python 3, numpy, pandas, matplotlib (see requirements.txt in the repo). Companion code archive: Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23220770 (semantic-miot-ntn v1.0).

Results page for the SPACOMM 2027 paper package — Rao S. Yenamandra, Mubanga Nsofu, Ram Asokan. Source data: results/ CSVs in the repository.
